en.hubeali:
A number of our companons, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Abu Al Bakhtary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who wears yellow sandals would be in delight until he renews them’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Muhammad ibn Ali from abu al-Bakhtariy who has said the following: “
If one wears yellow shoes he continues with happiness until that shoe becomes old.’”
